dialogue.content: (本日は貴重なお時間を頂きありがとうございます。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today. We will begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございます。本日はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。まず初めに年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 13歳、女、学校の友達のこと
dialogue.English: I'm 13, female, and it's about my friends at school.

dialogue.content: ご相談ありがとうございます。どのようなことか、詳しくお聞きしてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Would you mind telling me more about the situation?

dialogue.content: 友達と一緒の部活に入ったけど、その子が部活やめるって言ってて
dialogue.English: I joined a club with my friend, but now she says she's going to quit.

dialogue.content: 私はその子に押されて入ったから部活には友達いなくて
dialogue.English: She was the one who encouraged me to join, so I don't have any other friends in the club.

dialogue.content: しんどい
dialogue.English: It's tough.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それはおつらいですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうされたいと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to do about it?

dialogue.content: ほんとはやめたいです
dialogue.English: Honestly, I'd like to quit.

dialogue.content: けど、親はダメって言うし
dialogue.English: But my parents won't let me.

dialogue.content: 他に話せる相手がいない中で頑張るのは、しんどいと感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Trying to keep going without anyone else to talk to can feel very tough, can't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては、部活動はどうされたいですか？
dialogue.English: What do you personally want to do about the club?

dialogue.content: さっきも言いました
dialogue.English: I already told you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そうすると、部活動はお友達がいない中ではつつけたくないけれど、親が反対するのでやめられないという事でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, if I understand correctly, you don't want to continue with the club now that your friend has left, but you can't quit because your parents are against it. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やめるためにどうすればいいか、と言うご相談になりますねよね。
dialogue.English: So, your concern is about what you can do in order to quit, right?

dialogue.content: 親はなぜ反対されるとお感じですか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think your parents are against it?

dialogue.content: 親には高いお金払ったんだから、やめるなって言われました
dialogue.English: My parents told me, "We paid a lot of money for this, so you can't quit."

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そういわれても困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must put you in a difficult position.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それ以外には何か言われるとお感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think they might say anything else?

dialogue.content: 友達がいないからと言っても、そこで作ればいいって言われそうです
dialogue.English: Even if I say it's because I don't have any friends, they'll probably just tell me to make new ones there.

dialogue.content: いろいろ考えられてやめたいと思われたと感じるのですが、親の意見については、あなた自身はどう思われますか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've given this a lot of thought and decided you want to quit. How do you feel about your parents' opinion?

dialogue.content: 仕方ないなと思います
dialogue.English: I feel like there's nothing I can do.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね。しかたないと思うのは、どういったことでなのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: You feel that way, I see. What makes you feel that there's nothing you can do?

dialogue.content: 親だから
dialogue.English: Because they're my parents.

dialogue.content: なかなか話を聞いてもらえないと、普段から感じますか？
dialogue.English: Do you often feel like they don't really listen to you?

dialogue.content: それは思いません
dialogue.English: I don't think so.

dialogue.content: ぼっちなのはヤダから、友達も部活で作れば良いとは思ってるけどコミュ障だから
dialogue.English: I don't want to be alone, so I do think I should make friends in the club, but I'm socially awkward, so...

dialogue.content: ムリで
dialogue.English: It's impossible for me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご自身がお友達を作るのが苦手と感じるということですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that you have difficulty making friends?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仲の良いお友達がいなくなった中、自分からお友達を作るというのは勇気がいることですよね。
dialogue.English: It takes a lot of courage to try and make new friends on your own after your good friend has left.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コミュ障だと思われるのは、どういったことがありますか。
dialogue.English: What kinds of things make you feel you're socially awkward?

dialogue.content: 自分から話しかけられないです
dialogue.English: I can't initiate conversations.

dialogue.content: 顔を見て話せないし
dialogue.English: And I can't look people in the face when I talk.

dialogue.content: 声も小さいから
dialogue.English: My voice is too quiet.

dialogue.content: 自分から声かける自信もないです
dialogue.English: I don't have the confidence to approach people myself.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。顔置見て話すのはどうして苦手と感じますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Why do you feel it's difficult to look at people's faces when you talk?

dialogue.content: 相手の顔は見れません
dialogue.English: I just can't look at their faces.

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know why.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。今お話しいただいて、部活動どうやめるかの提案の前に、お友達にコミュニケーションをとる方法を一緒に考えたいなと思いましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Based on what you've shared, before we talk about how to quit the club, I was thinking we could explore some ways to communicate with your peers. How would you feel about that?

dialogue.content: 部活はやめたいです
dialogue.English: I want to quit the club.

dialogue.content: 同じ部活の子と私はキャラが違いすぎて仲良くなろうとはしてないんで
dialogue.English: The other kids in the club and I are just too different; I'm not trying to become friends with them.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そういったこともありますよね。他のお友達と話せるようになる事ではなく、部活動をやめるための方法を一緒に考えてみる。でよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. That can certainly be the case. So, instead of focusing on being able to talk with others, we'll work together on finding a way to quit the club. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。先ほどのお話の中で、親には話せるとの事でしたが
dialogue.English: Thank you. You mentioned earlier that you are able to talk to your parents.

dialogue.content: 反対されるのがしんどいので言えない。という事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: But it's too hard to bring it up because you know they'll oppose it. Is that right?

dialogue.content: なにか他に思われることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.content: やめたいと言ったら、高いお金払ったんだか続けなさいと言われました
dialogue.English: When I said I wanted to quit, they told me, "We paid a lot of money, so you have to continue."

dialogue.content: そういわれてしまうと、言いづらくなってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: When they say that, it makes it hard to speak up, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 続けていくしかないなと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought I had no choice but to continue.

dialogue.content: ご自身の思いと、親の思いが違うのはとてもしんどいことだと思います。
dialogue.English: It must be very hard when what you want and what your parents want are different.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までに、やめたい理由をきちんと話されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever been able to fully explain your reasons for wanting to quit?

dialogue.content: 言えていないです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to.

dialogue.content: 反対されたので
dialogue.English: Because they were against it.

dialogue.content: それ以上言えなくて
dialogue.English: I couldn't say anything more.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お友達がやめてしんどいと感じているあなたが部活をやめたいと思うのは、当然のことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. It's completely natural for you to want to quit, feeling so distressed after your friend left.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 親に反対されるのは、とてもつらいし、言いにくい事だとも思います。
dialogue.English: I imagine it's very painful and difficult to bring up something when you know your parents will be against it.

dialogue.content: わかってもらえなくて
dialogue.English: They don't understand...

dialogue.content: つらいです
dialogue.English: ...and it's painful.

dialogue.content: あなたが今まで悩みながらも部活動に言っていた事、とてもしんどかったと相談員は感じました。
dialogue.English: I can sense how hard it must have been for you to keep going to the club while struggling with these worries.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたが思っていることは当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I think your feelings are perfectly valid.

dialogue.content: やめるにはどうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do to quit?

dialogue.content: 親以外に周りに話せる人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone besides your parents you can talk to?

dialogue.content: 誰もいません
dialogue.English: There's no one.

dialogue.content: 人と喋るのが苦手なので
dialogue.English: Because I'm not good at talking to people.

dialogue.content: 他の人に話すのはしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: Talking to others can feel tough, can't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 言葉ではなく、他の方法でも無理そうですか？
dialogue.English: If not with words, would other methods be difficult as well?

dialogue.content: 例えば、手紙にご自身の思いを書いてみる
dialogue.English: For example, writing your feelings down in a letter.

dialogue.content: 書くことはできそうです
dialogue.English: I think I could write it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。話すとなると、難しい事でも、一方的にでもよいので思いを伝えるという事も大切かなと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Even when it's hard to talk, I think it can be important to convey your feelings, even if it's just one-way communication.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 誰に書いたらいいんですか？
dialogue.English: Who should I write it to?

dialogue.content: 一番伝えたい相手でいいかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？うまくいかなくても大丈夫ですよ。また、その時はご相談に来ていただきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I think you should write to the person you most want to tell. How does that sound? It's okay if it doesn't go perfectly. If that happens, I hope you'll come back and talk with me again.

dialogue.content: じゃあ、親に書いてみようと思います
dialogue.English: Then, I think I'll try writing to my parents.

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: 本日は時間が来てしまいましたので、またご相談に来ていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Our time is up for today, but would you be willing to come back for another session?

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ぜひ、親御さんに書いていただけたらと思います。応援しています。
dialogue.English: Please do try writing to your parents. I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for consulting with me today.

dialogue.content: （時間が過ぎてしまい申し訳ありません。率直な意見をぜひお願いいたします。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry we went over time. Please feel free to share your honest feedback. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
